mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:115-120: MODEL_BODY_HELM + i and its fellows load HelmClass{i+1}, ArmorClass{i+1} and the rest, and a character with no armour wears MODEL_BODY_* + SkinIndex (ZzzCharacter.cpp:12124-12346), numbered one over MU's zero-based classes -- so Class04 is the Magic Gladiator, class 3.
part_note: The arms and hands, 220 triangles. Bound to 61 on Bip01 L Forearm, 61 on Bip01 R Forearm, 23 on Bip01 L Hand, 23 on Bip01 R Hand, 11 on Bip01 L UpperArm, 11 on Bip01 R UpperArm, 8 on Bip01 L Finger0, 8 on Bip01 R Finger0.
sheet_from: Data/Player/HQSkin_special_01.OZJ (256x256), from the Season 17 client (third_party/MuClient_S17_v1.19.74). All five of the Magic Gladiator's parts name it.
model_from: Season 17's remake of MU's Magic Gladiator body, read out of Data/Player/GloveClass04.bmd in the S17 client: a version-14 file, which MuExtract opens through Webzen's ModulusCryptor (pipeline/MuExtract/MuAssets/Crypto). It replaced MuMain's GloveClass04 on 2026-10-15 at the user's call ("now fairy elf, then MG"). Its 51 bones are the first 51 of player.bmd's, by name and order, so it rides our rig and clips as MuMain's did.

material_note: leather for the glove, brass for the shoulder ring, bracer and studs, by uv_overrides.
